goal: A Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library (like pytesseract) to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules. No external APIs or cloud sync.
acceptance_criteria: invoice_parser module exists and can be imported
scan_directory function iterates over a provided path and identifies image/pdf files
extract_text function uses pytesseract to read image content
identify_fields function applies regex patterns to extract vendor, date, and amount
export_data function saves parsed results to CSV or JSON
